questions.question: Write an SQL query to show the first name and last name of all students in form 10B.
questions.correctAnswer: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Students WHERE Form = '10B'
questions.explanation: Answer: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Students WHERE Form = '10B'

questions.question: Write an SQL query to show all details of students whose last name starts with 'S', sorted by first name alphabetically.
questions.correctAnswer: SELECT * FROM Students WHERE LastName LIKE 'S%' ORDER BY FirstName ASC
questions.explanation: Answer: SELECT * FROM Students WHERE LastName LIKE 'S%' ORDER BY FirstName ASC

questions.question: Write an SQL statement to change Bob Jones's form from 10B to 11B and his year group to 11.
questions.correctAnswer: UPDATE Students SET Form = '11B', YearGroup = 11 WHERE StudentID = 1002
questions.explanation: Answer: UPDATE Students SET Form = '11B', YearGroup = 11 WHERE StudentID = 1002

questions.question: Write an SQL statement to delete all students in year group 11.
questions.explanation: Answer: DELETE FROM Students WHERE YearGroup = 11
